title: chylismia scapoidea subsp. macrocarpa
intro: Chylismia scapoidea subsp. macrocarpa, commonly known as the Desert Marigold, is a plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The Desert Marigold is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various ailments such as wounds, infections, and skin conditions. Its therapeutic actions include reducing pain, inflammation, and promoting wound healing through its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Chylismia scapoidea subsp. macrocarpa have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, contributing to its potential health benefits and therapeutic applications.
